newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania bourse activity rose last week.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania bourse activity rose last week.

text.p: The capitalisation of the Lithuanian stock exchange rose during the week of February 21-28 along with other activity indicators, the bourse said on Monday.
Capitalisation gained last week to 5.24 billion litas versus 5.03 billion the previous week, the bourse said in a statement.
The number of share transactions on the central market rose to 1,289 on turnover of 14.27 million litas last week versus 1,138 trades on turnover of 10.63 million litas a week before.
It also said that the number of bloc equity deals last week dropped to 122 from 161 a week before but turnover edged up to 5.18 million litas last week from 3.71 million a week before.
The bourse reported that last week share supply slipped to 54.37 million units from 54.46 million units a week before and demand crept down to 4.5 million units from 4.53 million units.

The share turnover in litas on the central market dipped to 4.39 million litas from 4.48 million litas and the share turnover in bloc trades rose slightly to 4.68 million litas from 3.71 million litas.
The number of transactions with government T-bills ticked down to 13 last week from 14 a week before but turnover advanced to 10.37 million litas from 6.15 million a week before.
Among the shares which rose most among the group A companies last week was the Birzai Milk dairy with a 31.6 percent rise to 10 litas, the bourse said.
